"""Adopt the exact suspended V147 worker after a user-requested pause."""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import signal
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live


def main(root):
    point = root / "resume-v1"
    path = point / "plan-v1.json"
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
    guard(training)
    worker = plan["adopted_worker"]
    assert live(worker) and psutil.Process(worker["pid"]).status() == psutil.STATUS_STOPPED
    assert all(not live(row["owner"]) for row in plan["replaced_controllers"])
    assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 52 * 2**30
    assert (
        shutil.disk_usage(root).free > 96 * 2**30
        and shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > 208 * 2**30
    )
    (point / "training-controller.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
        "resume_plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {"smoke": ref(root / "smoke-result-v1.json")},
        "phase": "train",
        "child": worker,
    }
    resumed = False
    try:
        save(root / "status-v1.json", {**state, "status": "running-declared-phase"})
        began = time.monotonic()
        os.kill(worker["pid"], signal.SIGCONT)
        resumed = True
        save(
            point / "continued-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "continued-original-worker-without-replay",
                "owner": worker,
                "controller": state["owner"],
                "recorded_unix_UTC": time.time(),
                "last_reported_progress": read(root / "train-progress-v1.json"),
                "new_worker_launches": 0,
                "new_noise_draws_by_controller": 0,
                "new_model_forwards_by_controller": 0,
            },
        )
        while live(worker):
            assert time.monotonic() - began < 7200, "Adopted worker timeout"
            assert psutil.Process(worker["pid"]).status() != psutil.STATUS_STOPPED, (
                "Worker unexpectedly suspended"
            )
            time.sleep(2)
        result = read(root / "train-result-v1.json")
        assert result["owner"] == worker and result["steps"] == 1000
        assert result["plan"] == ref(root / "plan-v1.json")
        assert result["counts"] == {
            "parent_root": 990,
            "DINO": 990,
            "module_training": 1000,
            "optimizer_updates": 1000,
            "adopted_parent_batches": 10,
        }
        assert result["parent_model_before"] == result["parent_model_after"]
        assert result["DINO_before"] == result["DINO_after"]
        guard(training)
        guard(plan)
        state["completed"]["train"] = ref(root / "train-result-v1.json")
        save(
            point / "completion-v1.json",
            {
                "status": "completed-adopted-original-worker",
                "plan": ref(path),
                "result": ref(root / "train-result-v1.json"),
                "worker_owner": worker,
                "worker_exited": True,
                "worker_exit_code": None,
                "scope": "Reparented worker is not this controller's child; terminal state and its complete verified result are observed, no exit code inferred. Exact in-memory training continued without checkpoint reload or replay.",
            },
        )
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-training-awaiting-quality-review"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if resumed and live(worker):
            os.kill(worker["pid"], signal.SIGSTOP)
        save(
            root / "status-v1.json",
            {
                **state,
                "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry",
                "error": repr(error),
                "worker_suspended_if_live": resumed and live(worker),
            },
        )
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    main(parser.parse_args().root.resolve())

postprocess_controller.source:
"""Queue a frozen late-spectral review after its fixed training horizon."""

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from review_v146_window_transfer import relocated_controller_source
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live

REPO = Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')


def prepare(root):
    training = read(root / "plan-v1.json")
    guard(training)
    work = root / "postprocess-v1/scripts"
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    names = [
        "score_late_spectral_trial.py",
        "audit_late_spectral_trial.py",
        "render_late_spectral_trial.py",
        "audit_late_spectral_figures.py",
        "report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py",
        "report_checkpoint_pilot.py",
        "review_v146_window_transfer.py",
    ]
    for name in names:
        shutil.copyfile(REPO / "scripts" / name, work / name)
    runner = work / Path(__file__).name
    runner.write_text(relocated_controller_source(Path(__file__).read_text(), REPO))
    stages = [
        {
            "name": "review",
            "argv": [str(root / "review-source-v1.py"), "worker", str(root)],
            "result": str(root / "review-result-v1.json"),
        },
        *(
            {"name": name, "argv": [str(work / filename), str(root)], "result": str(root / result)}
            for name, filename, result in [
                ("scores", "score_late_spectral_trial.py", "scores-v1.json"),
                (
                    "metric-audit",
                    "audit_late_spectral_trial.py",
                    "independent-metrics-audit-v1.json",
                ),
                ("render", "render_late_spectral_trial.py", "figures-v1.json"),
                (
                    "pixel-audit",
                    "audit_late_spectral_figures.py",
                    "independent-figures-audit-v1.json",
                ),
            ]
        ),
        {
            "name": "mixed-controls",
            "argv": [str(root / "mixed-quiet-v1/operator-v1.py"), "worker", str(root)],
            "result": str(root / "mixed-quiet-v1/result-v1.json"),
        },
        {
            "name": "mixed-report",
            "argv": [str(work / "report_late_spectral_mixed_quiet.py"), str(root)],
            "result": str(root / "mixed-quiet-v1/report-v1.json"),
        },
    ]
    save(
        root / "postprocess-plan-v1.json",
        {
            "root": str(root),
            "work": str(work),
            "runner": ref(runner),
            "python": str(REPO / ".venv/bin/python"),
            "training_plan": ref(root / "plan-v1.json"),
            "stages": stages,
            "inputs": [
                ref(root / p)
                for p in (
                    "plan-v1.json",
                    "review-plan-v1.json",
                    "mixed-quiet-v1/plan-v1.json",
                    "mixed-quiet-v1/scope-clarification-v1.json",
                )
            ]
            + [ref(root / "review-source-v1.py"), ref(root / "mixed-quiet-v1/operator-v1.py")],
            "frozen_files": {str(p): ref(p)["sha256"] for p in work.glob("*.py")},
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 32,
            "new_module_forwards": 1596,
            "new_noise_draws_in_postprocess": 0,
            "scope": "Wait for fixed1000; execute both endpoints, audits, native figures and32 prepared mixed controls. No retraining, endpoint selection or automatic retries. Actual human native viewing and interpretation remain required after completion.",
        },
    )


def controller(root):
    path = root / "postprocess-plan-v2.json"
    plan = read(path)
    guard(plan)
    assert ref(__file__) == plan["runner"]
    (root / "resume-v1/postprocess.claim").open("x").close()
    state = {
        "plan": ref(path),
        "owner": {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()},
        "completed": {},
    }
    child = child_owner = None
    try:
        start = time.monotonic()
        while True:
            training_status = read(root / "status-v1.json")
            if training_status["status"] == "completed-training-awaiting-quality-review":
                break
            assert training_status["status"] != "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", (
                training_status
            )
            assert live(training_status["owner"]) and time.monotonic() - start < 10800
            save(
                root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
                {**state, "status": "waiting-for-fixed-training-horizon"},
            )
            time.sleep(5)
        training = read(plan["training_plan"]["path"])
        for stage in plan["stages"]:
            guard(plan)
            guard(training)
            start = time.monotonic()
            while psutil.virtual_memory().available < 52 * 2**30:
                assert time.monotonic() - start < 7200
                save(
                    root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
                    {**state, "status": "waiting-for-headroom", "stage": stage["name"]},
                )
                time.sleep(5)
            env = dict(
                os.environ,
                PYTHONPATH=f"{training['work']}/src:{plan['work']}:{training['work']}/scripts",
                OMP_NUM_THREADS="2",
                OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1",
                MKL_NUM_THREADS="1",
                HF_HUB_OFFLINE="1",
                TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE="1",
                CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0",
                CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=":4096:8",
            )
            with (root / f"postprocess-{stage['name']}-v1.log").open("x") as log:
                child = subprocess.Popen(
                    [plan["python"], "-P", *stage["argv"]],
                    cwd=root,
                    env=env,
                    stdout=log,
                    stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                    stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                    start_new_session=True,
                )
                child_owner = {"pid": child.pid, "created": psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
                save(
                    root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
                    {
                        **state,
                        "status": "running-frozen-stage",
                        "stage": stage["name"],
                        "child": child_owner,
                    },
                )
                assert child.wait(timeout=1800) == 0, stage["name"]
            assert not live(child_owner)
            state["completed"][stage["name"]] = {
                "result": ref(stage["result"]),
                "owner": child_owner,
                "owner_exited": True,
            }
        save(
            root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "completed-audited-arrays-awaiting-human-native-viewing"},
        )
    except BaseException as error:
        if child is not None and child.poll() is None and live(child_owner):
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            child.wait(timeout=30)
        save(
            root / "postprocess-status-v1.json",
            {**state, "status": "failed-preserved-no-automatic-retry", "error": repr(error)},
        )
        raise


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("prepare", "controller"))
    parser.add_argument("root", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    (prepare if args.mode == "prepare" else controller)(args.root.resolve())
